Community Evidence Packet Workbench

Assemble a local packet. Hash the bytes you loaded. Export HTML, Markdown, JSON, ZIP, RO-Crate, or BagIt. Print or copy. Every control stays available, including for empty packets.

Open door. No accounts, no sign-in, no permission gate. After this page has loaded, work stays in this browser. SHA-256 here is local byte identity, not authenticity or legal proof. WACZ files are stored as opaque attachments and are not opened.

Packet

Evidence items

Files are read locally. Hashes are computed from the bytes in memory. Size notices are advisory and never hide export.

Export

Empty and incomplete packets still export. Missing fields are labeled in the snapshot.
